# LIONOVART

> LIONOVART is a Calgary, Alberta–based multidisciplinary creative and digital
> agency for ambitious founders. One studio delivers brand identity, web & app
> design and development, video & social content, print, AI systems, and growth
> marketing — every discipline in-house, founder-direct. Tagline: "We build
> brands that roar." The team works across 9 languages and has delivered work
> on 4 continents.

## Contact
- Website: https://lionovart.com
- Email: connect@lionovart.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +1-587-897-4772
- Location: Calgary, Alberta, Canada (serving Calgary, Canada, the UK, and Europe)

## Services
- Brand Identity & Strategy — https://lionovart.com/services/brand
  Logo systems, visual identity, typography, brand voice, sonic identity, guidelines.
- Web & App Design & Development — https://lionovart.com/services/web
  Custom websites, web apps, UI/UX, e-commerce, CMS, SEO, voice/automation agents.
- Content Studio (Video & Social) — https://lionovart.com/services/content-studio
  Brand films, social reels, motion design, full social media content & strategy.
- Print & Physical Branding — cards, packaging, signage, apparel, event branding (Calgary).
- Smart Systems & AI — voice agents, automations, chatbots, CRM/email workflows.
- Growth Marketing — SEO/AEO, Google Business Profile optimization, local search, analytics.

## How engagements work
- Sprint model: most brand + website projects run 4–6 weeks.
- Payment: 50% deposit to reserve the schedule; remainder on delivery.
- Getting started: a short 20–30 minute discovery call via WhatsApp or the website form.

## Differentiators
- One contact across every medium — no freelancer coordination.
- AI-native: voice agents and automation built in-house.
- Multilingual delivery (9 languages), international experience (4 continents).
- Premium creative quality with founder-direct speed.
